text:
Rhea: quick thought 1: what if the time-range stays docked to the top but becomes translucent when overlapping the heatmap? keeps context but reduces visual weight. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/dock-translucent

Omar: translucency is neat but watch contrast for the sampling chip. when translucent over dark heatmap the chip may lose legibility. we could give the chip a solid backdrop or a subtle blur behind it.

Lina: accessibility: blur behind text is problematic for readability and performance. prefer a semi-opaque solid for the control background and ensure at least 4.5:1 contrast. also ensure the sticky control has clear focus outlines and a role=region label.

QA-Bot: automated check: translucent header with chip color #FFFFFF at 80% over heatmap fails contrast at 12px. Recommend solid token for chip background and white text. Also flag: tooltip overlap test failed when sticky present; tooltip clipped in iOS Safari.

Ava: tooltip strategy idea: prefer placing tooltip above the point if sticky header would occlude it. if above isn't available, nudge canvas up by stickyHeight with a smooth motion (respect prefers-reduced-motion). Also make the tooltip pointer a tiny chevron so it reads as connected.

Rhea: actionables: 1) I'll update Figma with a translucent dock + solid-chip variant. 2) update chip token to solid bg per QA-Bot. 3) add aria-live for sampling updates and role=region for sticky bar. @Omar can you prototype the micro-blur vs solid fallback? @Lina can you run keyboard + screen reader checks on the solid-chip variant? @Ava can prototype tooltip-above + nudge behavior in the playground?

Omar: will prototype both in the playground this afternoon.

Lina: will run a quick VoiceOver + keyboard pass tomorrow morning.

Ava: will mock tooltip placement rules and share a short clip by EOD.

Rhea: cool — will keep this thread as canonical and will open a tiny PR for the token change after figma updates.

Omar: :thumbsup:

Lina: thanks!

QA-Bot: rerun checks after PR.
